name: Folio
title: Make room for the things that matter.
summary: A budgeting concept that turns everyday spending into a simple weekly plan, without overwhelming charts.
audience: Young adults building their first sustainable budgeting routine.
problem: Monthly dashboards can show where money went without helping someone decide what they can safely spend today.
question: How might we translate a monthly budget into a manageable weekly decision?
value: A weekly plan, with room to breathe.
description: Flexible spending groups and a clear weekly allowance help people understand trade-offs before making a purchase.
insight: A useful budget should explain the next decision, rather than only summarize past transactions.

process.title: Discovery

process.title: Define
process.description: A useful budget should explain the next decision, rather than only summarize past transactions.

process.title: Design

process.title: Review
process.description: Prepare a usability study to evaluate comprehension, recovery, and task completion. No study results are claimed.

architecture.description: Four connected destinations organize the primary journey. Each step retains context so people can review their choices before continuing.

wireframes.description: Wireframes explore the hierarchy between available funds, spending groups, and recent activity. Amounts remain contextual and are never presented as a financial recommendation.

screens.description: Illustrative interface compositions for this fictional concept; not screenshots of a released product.

designSystem.description: A compact foundation of clear type, consistent spacing, and reusable controls supports the main journey.
designSystem.typography: Inter for interface text · Playfair Display for editorial headings

closing.title: Designed to make the next step clearer.
closing.description: Next steps would test how irregular income and shared expenses affect the weekly planning model.
